title: CRM Forms & Compliance-Aware Tracking
summary: Made marketing forms behave the same everywhere — and tracking respect each market's rules.
problem: Form logic was scattered through site templates, success states were hidden, and tracking ignored per-market consent rules.
solution: Refactored form HTML/JavaScript into components, standardised validation, consent and legal rows, disabled open/click tracking where required and adjusted segmentation; supported containerised deployments and environment diagnostics.
result: Consistent validation and consent messaging across forms, with tracking that matches compliance requirements.
